items.stem: A frontend formatting rule is being applied to backend files too. What is the most likely fix?

options.text: Scope the rule to the frontend path instead of leaving it global
options.rationale: Correct: path-scoping limits a rule to the intended part of the repo.
Removing every rule discards useful conventions.
Length does not control which files a rule applies to.
Renaming source files to satisfy a mis-scoped rule is the wrong lever.

items.stem: Which TWO qualities make a repository rule more likely to be followed? (Select TWO.)

options.text: It is specific and states the exact convention
options.rationale: Correct: specific, actionable wording is easier for the agent to apply.

options.text: It is scoped to where it is relevant
options.rationale: Correct: appropriate scope avoids conflicts and noise.

options.text: It is a long essay covering many topics
options.rationale: Overlong rules are hard to act on.
